name: record_term
description: Teach the lexicon a term the transcriber gets wrong, so it is right next time. Call it when you learn the correct form of something, whether from a lookup or because they spelled it out. A correction only becomes usable as a spelling fix if something here already knows the term; otherwise it still improves transcription, but keep writing what they actually said.

heard_as.description: Ways the transcriber has rendered it wrong. These become automatic corrections.

definition.description: One line on what it is, only if you actually know.
